text:
mika: quick check 1 — trying a compact layout for the Playground stream footer: token meter + stop/regenerate + tiny prompt quick-insert. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compact-footer

ben: footer makes sense. keeps actions grouped with send. question: should the token meter be visible only while streaming or always?

claire: default to show only while streaming, add user setting to persist. new users get less noise.

omear: backend note 1: 'Stop' = discard partial state; we don't reliably support resume. so use 'Stop' language, not 'Pause'.

juno: a11y nit 1: token meter needs aria-live with debounced updates (400-600ms). stop button needs aria-label: "Stop response and discard partial output". Also provide Esc shortcut to stop.

mika: agree on debounce 500ms. will set aria-live="polite" and announce final token count with role="status".

ben: microcopy: regen button label: "Regenerate". tooltip: "Regenerate response with same prompt". keep it explicit.

claire: visual: token pill contrast on light theme low. use #111827 bg + #F9FAFB text or add 1px border.

juno: keyboard flow proposal: don't shift focus when streaming starts, but ensure stop is reachable by one Tab after send. also add aria-pressed if we ever make it a toggle.

mika: sounds good. I'll update comps and hand off to eng tomorrow. will post screenshots after update. :sparkles:
